svg.title: Mount of Olives · registered bold registered intaglio foil master V10
svg.desc: Original full-height heavy-register vector letterpress master for masked OS gold ink: irregular Mount of Olives ridgeline, olive grove with slender lanceolate foliage, and distant Jerusalem city silhouette; localized old-gold foil engraving for the invited-sermon print. Not a Bible-cover ornament.
